title: Dunjunz, Ole's crack of the cassette (1986)
notes: DUNJ4 and DUNJ3 from Dunjunz-tape.zip in the NVG archive, a crack of the 1986 cassette by Ole ("The great Demon from Denmark"). DUNJ4 (the figures above) is the game's &0400-&2FFF image stored at &2400, followed by start-up code at &5000 that copies it into place and applies the cracker's start-level cheat. DUNJ3 (load &6E80, 11904 bytes; SHA-256 03d92abc11b36d22e2a9a7365ee90aa47f32aa6d2e243188e3f5fdc423abbd22) holds &6E80-&7FFF. The levels are stored decrypted and loaded with *LOAD. The listing saves both files.
